title: 7-Day Garden Route Safari Adventure from Cape Town
includes: Scenic drive from Cape Town to Wilderness, George, or Mossel Bay
Cango Caves & Visit to Birds of Eden

requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover Your Journey: 7-Day Garden Route Safari Adventure from Cape Town offers travellers an immersive experience through South Africa's stunning Garden Route, renowned for its diverse landscapes and rich wildlife. Over the course of seven days, participants embark on a well-crafted itinerary that highlights breathtaking coastal scenery, lush forests, and vibrant towns, while also providing opportunities for thrilling activities such as safari drives and whale watching. The adventure begins in Cape Town, leading to iconic destinations such as Knysna and Plettenberg Bay, where visitors can engage in outdoor pursuits and explore local culture. With accommodations ranging from luxury lodges to charming guesthouses, this safari not only promises adventure and exploration but also ensures a comfortable and memorable journey through one of the country’s most picturesque regions.
